mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, avatar, role, vip_expire_date, status, mute_status, mute_end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, phone, avatar, role, vip_expire_date, status, mute_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{vipExpireDate}, #{status}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, avatar, role, vip_expire_date, status, mute_status, mute_end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT (role = 'ADMIN') OR (vip_expire_date IS NOT NULL AND vip_expire_date >= CURRENT_DATE) FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, avatar, role, vip_expire_date, status, mute_status, mute_end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, email, phone, role, vip_expire_date, status, mute_status, mute_end_date, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at < #{endDate}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET mute_status = #{muteStatus}, mute_end_date = #{muteEndDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS register_date, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY register_date ASC
